findings.heading: RStudio as administrator / RStudio với tư cách quản trị viên
findings.proposition: English: the click that opens RStudio must itself be a right-click ('When you click the RStudio icon to open RStudio, do so with a right-click'). Vietnamese: click the icon to open RStudio, and then right-click ('Bạn cần nhấp vào biểu tượng RStudio để mở RStudio, sau đó bấm chuột phải').
findings.reader_consequence: The Vietnamese reader launches RStudio normally as a non-administrator, then right-clicks with nothing useful to right-click on. The 'Run as Administrator' context menu never appears, so the reader cannot carry out the very first overarching principle of the chapter (principle 1, get administrator access).

findings.heading: Troubleshooting common errors / Khắc phục các lỗi thường gặp (Pandoc Error 83)
findings.proposition: English: R may be unable to find the file of the **rmarkdown** package itself, so check which library the **rmarkdown** package lives in. Vietnamese: R may be unable to find 'các package sử dụng trong file **rmarkdown**' (the packages used inside the rmarkdown file), so check which library 'package trong **rmarkdown**' (the package inside rmarkdown) is stored in.
findings.reader_consequence: The Vietnamese reader diagnoses Pandoc Error 83 by auditing the packages their .Rmd document loads, instead of locating the rmarkdown package itself with find.package('rmarkdown'). They never find the inaccessible '\\\' library holding rmarkdown, so they never apply the fix the same paragraph goes on to describe (moving rmarkdown to a C: library).

findings.heading: Overview / Tổng quan
findings.proposition: English: save packages to a library on a 'lettered drive' (any drive addressed by a letter). Vietnamese: save packages to a library on an 'ổ cứng vật lý' (a physical hard drive).
findings.reader_consequence: A mapped network drive is lettered but not physical. The Vietnamese overarching principle therefore excludes exactly the workaround the chapter recommends later under 'Định vị các ổ đĩa mạng' (map the network location to a lettered drive and use the drive-letter path), so a reader with no local disk available concludes the principle cannot be satisfied.

findings.heading: Troubleshooting common errors / Khắc phục các lỗi thường gặp (Pandoc 1 error)
findings.proposition: English states the fix is one of ORDERING: of the multiple library locations, have the lettered-drive one 'listed first'. The Vietnamese omits 'listed first' and instructs the reader only to 'chọn' (choose/pick) a location beginning with a letter.
findings.reader_consequence: The Vietnamese reader does not learn that the remedy is to reorder .libPaths() so the lettered library comes first, which is precisely what the 'Switch order of libraries' chunk the bullet cross-references does. They treat it as a one-off choice of install target and leave the '\\\' library still ahead in the search order, so pandoc error 1 recurs.
